-- calls Luau turns into FASTCALL or folds when the arguments are constants: math, bit32, string
-- and buffer, with arguments at their edges, and the same builtins through locals and upvalues
print(math.floor(-2.5), math.ceil(-2.5), math.abs(-0), math.max(1, 5, 3), math.min(-1, -5), math.sign(-3))
print(math.floor(2 ^ 31 + 0.5), math.fmod(-7, 3), math.fmod(7, -3), math.clamp(15, 0, 10), math.round(-2.5))
print(bit32.band(0xff, -1), bit32.bor(1, 2, 4), bit32.bxor(5, 3), bit32.bnot(0), bit32.lshift(1, 31))
print(bit32.rshift(-1, 28), bit32.arshift(-16, 2), bit32.extract(0xabcd, 4, 8), bit32.replace(0, 7, 4, 3))
print(bit32.countlz(1), bit32.countrz(8), bit32.lrotate(1, 33), bit32.btest(6, 1), bit32.byteswap(0x01020304))
print(string.byte("ABC", 1, -1), string.char(72, 105), ("x"):rep(3, "-"), ("Hello"):sub(-3), ("Hi"):len())
print(("%5.2f|%-4d|%x|%s"):format(3.14159, 7, 255, "s"), ("a,b,,c"):split(",")[3] == "", #("a,b,,c"):split(","))
print(("hello world"):gsub("o", "0"), ("abc"):gsub("%w", "%0%0"), ("x=1 y=2"):gsub("(%w)=(%w)", "%2=%1"))
print(("key=val"):match("(%w+)=(%w+)"), ("  trim  "):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"), ("a1b2"):find("%d"))
print(tonumber("0x10"), tonumber("10", 2), tonumber(" 5 "), tonumber("5e2"), tonumber("abc"), tonumber("z", 36))
print(type(nil), typeof(1), select("#", 1, nil, nil), select(-1, "a", "b"), rawlen({ 1, 2, 3 }), rawlen("abcd"))

local buf = buffer.create(16)
buffer.writeu8(buf, 0, 255)
buffer.writei16(buf, 1, -2)
buffer.writef32(buf, 4, 1.5)
buffer.writestring(buf, 8, "rosetta")
print(buffer.readu8(buf, 0), buffer.readi8(buf, 0), buffer.readi16(buf, 1), buffer.readu16(buf, 1))
print(buffer.readf32(buf, 4), buffer.readstring(buf, 8, 7), buffer.len(buf), buffer.tostring(buf):byte(9))

-- the same builtins through locals and upvalues, which compile differently
local floor, band, sub = math.floor, bit32.band, string.sub
local function viaUpvalues(v)
	return floor(v), band(v, 3), sub("abcdef", v, v + 1)
end
print(viaUpvalues(2), viaUpvalues(5))

-- a global that shadows a builtin library stops it being treated as one
local saved = math
local function sneaky()
	local math = { floor = function()
		return "shadowed"
	end }
	return math.floor(1.5)
end
print(sneaky(), saved.floor(1.5))

local t = { 3, 1, 2 }
table.sort(t, function(x, y)
	return x > y
end)
table.insert(t, 1, 0)
print(table.concat(t, ","), table.remove(t), table.find(t, 3), #table.create(3, "x"), table.unpack({ 1, 2, 3 }, 2))

-- A tokenizer and recursive-descent parser for arithmetic, with variables and errors.

local function tokenize(source)
	local tokens = {}
	local i = 1
	while i <= #source do
		local c = source:sub(i, i)
		if c:match("%s") then
			i += 1
		elseif c:match("%d") then
			local number = source:match("^%d+%.?%d*", i)
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = "number", value = tonumber(number) })
			i += #number
		elseif c:match("[%a_]") then
			local name = source:match("^[%a_][%w_]*", i)
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = "name", value = name })
			i += #name
		elseif c:match("[%+%-%*/%^%(%)=]") then
			table.insert(tokens, { kind = c })
			i += 1
		else
			error(`unexpected character '{c}' at {i}`, 0)
		end
	end
	table.insert(tokens, { kind = "end" })
	return tokens
end

local Parser = {}
Parser.__index = Parser

function Parser.new(tokens, variables)
	return setmetatable({ tokens = tokens, pos = 1, variables = variables }, Parser)
end

function Parser:peek()
	return self.tokens[self.pos].kind
end

function Parser:take(kind)
	local token = self.tokens[self.pos]
	if kind and token.kind ~= kind then
		error(`expected {kind}, got {token.kind}`, 0)
	end
	self.pos += 1
	return token
end

local PRECEDENCE = { ["+"] = 1, ["-"] = 1, ["*"] = 2, ["/"] = 2, ["^"] = 3 }

function Parser:primary()
	local token = self:take()
	if token.kind == "number" then
		return token.value
	elseif token.kind == "name" then
		local value = self.variables[token.value]
		if value == nil then
			error(`unknown variable {token.value}`, 0)
		end
		return value
	elseif token.kind == "-" then
		return -self:expression(3)
	elseif token.kind == "(" then
		local value = self:expression(0)
		self:take(")")
		return value
	end
	error(`unexpected {token.kind}`, 0)
end

function Parser:expression(minimum)
	local left = self:primary()
	while true do
		local op = self:peek()
		local precedence = PRECEDENCE[op]
		if not precedence or precedence <= minimum and op ~= "^" or precedence < minimum then
			return left
		end
		self:take()
		local right = self:expression(op == "^" and precedence - 1 or precedence)
		if op == "+" then
			left += right
		elseif op == "-" then
			left -= right
		elseif op == "*" then
			left *= right
		elseif op == "/" then
			if right == 0 then
				error("division by zero", 0)
			end
			left /= right
		else
			left ^= right
		end
	end
end

local function run(line, variables)
	local tokens = tokenize(line)
	local target
	if tokens[2].kind == "=" then
		target = tokens[1].value
		table.remove(tokens, 1)
		table.remove(tokens, 1)
	end
	local parser = Parser.new(tokens, variables)
	local value = parser:expression(0)
	parser:take("end")
	if target then
		variables[target] = value
	end
	return value
end

local variables = { pi = math.pi }
for _, line in { "x = 2 + 3 * 4", "y = (x - 4) ^ 2 / 2", "x * y - -3", "r = 2", "pi * r ^ 2", "1 / (x - 14)", "z + 1", "3 $ 4" } do
	local ok, result = pcall(run, line, variables)
	print(line, "=>", if ok then string.format("%.4g", result) else `error: {result}`)
end

	return tokens
end

local Parser = {}
Parser.__index = Parser

function Parser.new(tokens, variables)
	return setmetatable({ tokens = tokens, pos = 1, variables = variables }, Parser)
end

function Parser:peek()
	return self.tokens[self.pos].kind
end

function Parser:take(kind)
	local token = self.tokens[self.pos]
	if kind and token.kind ~= kind then
		error(`expected {kind}, got {token.kind}`, 0)
	end
	self.pos += 1
	return token
end

local PRECEDENCE = { ["+"] = 1, ["-"] = 1, ["*"] = 2, ["/"] = 2, ["^"] = 3 }

function Parser:primary()
	local token = self:take()
	if token.kind == "number" then
		return token.value
	elseif token.kind == "name" then
		local value = self.variables[token.value]
		if value == nil then
			error(`unknown variable {token.value}`, 0)
		end
		return value
	elseif token.kind == "-" then
		return -self:expression(3)
	elseif token.kind == "(" then
		local value = self:expression(0)
		self:take(")")
		return value
	end
	error(`unexpected {token.kind}`, 0)
end

function Parser:expression(minimum)
	local left = self:primary()
	while true do
		local op = self:peek()
		local precedence = PRECEDENCE[op]
		if not precedence or precedence <= minimum and op ~= "^" or precedence < minimum then
			return left
		end
		self:take()
		local right = self:expression(op == "^" and precedence - 1 or precedence)
		if op == "+" then
			left += right
		elseif op == "-" then
			left -= right
		elseif op == "*" then
			left *= right
		elseif op == "/" then
			if right == 0 then
				error("division by zero", 0)
			end
			left /= right
		else
			left ^= right
		end
	end
end

local function run(line, variables)
	local tokens = tokenize(line)
	local target
	if tokens[2].kind == "=" then
		target = tokens[1].value
		table.remove(tokens, 1)
		table.remove(tokens, 1)
	end
	local parser = Parser.new(tokens, variables)
	local value = parser:expression(0)
	parser:take("end")
	if target then
		variables[target] = value
	end
	return value
end

for _, line in { "x = 2 + 3 * 4", "y = (x - 4) ^ 2 / 2", "x * y - -3", "r = 2", "pi * r ^ 2", "1 / (x - 14)", "z + 1", "3 $ 4" } do
	local ok, result = pcall(run, line, variables)
	print(line, "=>", if ok then string.format("%.4g", result) else `error: {result}`)
end

local function classify(n)
	if n < 0 then
		return "negative"
	elseif n == 0 then
		return "zero"
	elseif n % 2 == 0 then
		return "even"
	else
		return "odd"
	end
end

local function sumUntil(limit)
	local total, i = 0, 1
	while total < limit do
		total += i
		i += 1
	end
	return total, i
end

local function firstPrimeAfter(n)
	local candidate = n
	repeat
		candidate += 1
		local prime = candidate > 1
		for d = 2, math.floor(math.sqrt(candidate)) do
			if candidate % d == 0 then
				prime = false
				break
			end
		end
	until prime
	return candidate
end

-- generic for without an iterator function: plain tables (array part, then hash part), __iter
-- returning a closure or next, objects with __call, coroutines, and pairs and ipairs, which the
-- compiler turns into their own loop instructions
local function keys(t)
	local out = {}
	for k in t do
		table.insert(out, tostring(k))
	end
	table.sort(out)
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

local list = { "a", "b", "c" }
for i, v in list do
	print("plain", i, v)
end
for i, v in ipairs(list) do
	print("ipairs", i, v)
end
for i, v in pairs(list) do
	print("pairs", i, v)
end
print(keys({ x = 1, y = 2, [3] = true, [true] = 0 }))

-- a hole: ipairs stops at it, a plain loop and pairs walk past it
local holes = { 1, 2, nil, 4 }
local viaIpairs, viaPlain, viaPairs = 0, 0, 0
for _ in ipairs(holes) do
	viaIpairs += 1
end
for _ in holes do
	viaPlain += 1
end
for _ in pairs(holes) do
	viaPairs += 1
end
print(viaIpairs, viaPlain, viaPairs)

-- __iter returning a stateful closure
local Range = {}
Range.__index = Range
Range.__iter = function(self)
	local i = self.from - self.step
	return function()
		i += self.step
		if i <= self.to then
			return i, i * i
		end
		return nil
	end
end
local function range(from, to, step)
	return setmetatable({ from = from, to = to, step = step or 1 }, Range)
end
for v, sq in range(1, 7, 3) do
	print("range", v, sq)
end

-- __iter handing back next and another table to walk
local Bag = {
	__iter = function(self)
		return next, self.items
	end,
}
local bag = setmetatable({ items = { "x", "y" }, hidden = true }, Bag)
for k, v in bag do
	print("bag", k, v)
end

-- an object with __call is the iterator function itself
local countdown = setmetatable({ n = 3 }, {
	__call = function(self)
		if self.n > 0 then
			self.n -= 1
			return self.n + 1
		end
		return nil
	end,
})
for v in countdown do
	print("countdown", v)
end

-- a coroutine as the iterator
for v in coroutine.wrap(function()
	for i = 1, 3 do
		coroutine.yield(i * 2)
	end
end) do
	print("co", v)
end

-- continue, break and writing the loop variable inside generalized loops
for i, v in list do
	if v == "b" then
		continue
	end
	i *= 10
	print("skip b", i, v)
end
local found
for i, v in { 5, 6, 7, 8 } do
	if v % 2 == 1 and i > 1 then
		found = i
		break
	end
end
print("found", found)

	for c, cell in row do

	end
end
print("grid", sum)

for round = 1, 3 do

	for _ in growing do

	end

	print("round", round, seen)
end

-- small local functions that -O2 copies into their callers
local log = {}

local function tap(tag, value)
	table.insert(log, tag)
	return value
end

local function clamp(x, lo, hi)
	if x < lo then
		return lo
	elseif x > hi then
		return hi
	end
	return x
end

local function guard(value)
	if not value then
		return
	end
	table.insert(log, "guarded " .. tostring(value))
end

local counter = 0
local function bump(by)
	counter += by
end

local sum = tap("l", 1) + tap("r", 2) * tap("m", 3)
local short = tap("p", false) and tap("q", 1) or tap("z", 2)
local tbl = {}
tbl[tap("ck", "count")] = (tbl.count or 0) + tap("cv", 1)

for i = -2, 12, 5 do
	print(i, clamp(i, 0, 10))
	bump(i)
end

guard(nil)
guard("yes")

local function scaled(n)
	return clamp(n * 2, 1, 9)
end

if clamp(sum, 0, 5) == 5 and scaled(3) > 4 then
	print("both")
end

while counter > 0 do
	counter -= clamp(counter, 1, 7)
	if counter % 3 == 0 then
		break
	end
end

print(sum, short, tbl.count, counter, table.concat(log, ","))

--!strict
-- An inventory with stacking, weight limits and a sorted report.

local Inventory = {}
Inventory.__index = Inventory

local ITEMS = {
	sword = { weight = 8, stack = 1, value = 120 },
	potion = { weight = 1, stack = 10, value = 25 },
	arrow = { weight = 0.1, stack = 64, value = 1 },
	shield = { weight = 12, stack = 1, value = 90 },
}

function Inventory.new(capacity)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Inventory)
	self.capacity = capacity
	self.slots = {}
	self.weight = 0
	return self
end

local function round(n, places)
	local scale = 10 ^ places
	return math.floor(n * scale + 0.5) / scale
end

function Inventory:add(name, count)
	local info = ITEMS[name]
	if not info then
		return false, `unknown item {name}`
	end
	if self.weight + info.weight * count > self.capacity then
		return false, `too heavy: {round(self.weight + info.weight * count, 1)} > {self.capacity}`
	end
	local left = count
	for _, slot in self.slots do
		if slot.name == name and slot.count < info.stack then
			local moved = math.min(info.stack - slot.count, left)
			slot.count += moved
			left -= moved
			if left == 0 then
				break
			end
		end
	end
	while left > 0 do
		local moved = math.min(info.stack, left)
		table.insert(self.slots, { name = name, count = moved })
		left -= moved
	end
	self.weight += info.weight * count
	return true
end

function Inventory:remove(name, count)
	for i = #self.slots, 1, -1 do
		local slot = self.slots[i]
		if slot.name ~= name then
			continue
		end
		local taken = math.min(slot.count, count)
		slot.count -= taken
		count -= taken
		self.weight -= ITEMS[name].weight * taken
		if slot.count == 0 then
			table.remove(self.slots, i)
		end
		if count == 0 then
			return true
		end
	end
	return count == 0
end

function Inventory:report()
	local totals = {}
	for _, slot in self.slots do
		totals[slot.name] = (totals[slot.name] or 0) + slot.count
	end
	local names = {}
	for name in totals do
		table.insert(names, name)
	end
	table.sort(names, function(a, b)
		return ITEMS[a].value * totals[a] > ITEMS[b].value * totals[b]
	end)
	local lines = {}
	for rank, name in names do
		lines[rank] = `{rank}. {name} x{totals[name]} ({ITEMS[name].value * totals[name]}g)`
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n"), round(self.weight, 2)
end

local bag = Inventory.new(40)
print(bag:add("arrow", 150))
print(bag:add("potion", 12))
print(bag:add("sword", 1))
print(bag:add("shield", 3))
print(bag:add("wand", 1))
print(bag:remove("arrow", 70), bag:remove("potion", 20))
print(bag:report())

-- closures made in loops: each iteration of a for loop has its own variable, a while loop's
-- local is fresh each time round, and an upvalue written after capture is shared
local fns = {}
for i = 1, 3 do
	fns[#fns + 1] = function()
		return i
	end
end
local k = 0
while k < 3 do
	k += 1
	local j = k * 10
	fns[#fns + 1] = function()
		return j
	end
end
for _, v in ipairs({ "a", "b" }) do
	local copy = v
	fns[#fns + 1] = function()
		copy = copy .. "!"
		return copy
	end
end
for idx, f in ipairs(fns) do
	print(idx, f(), f())
end

-- one variable captured by two closures, then changed from outside
local function counter()
	local n = 0
	local function inc()
		n += 1
		return n
	end
	local function get()
		return n
	end
	n = 100
	return inc, get
end
local inc, get = counter()
inc()
print(get(), inc(), get())

-- a loop variable shadowed inside the body, and the outer one read after
local total = 0
for i = 1, 4 do
	local i = i * 2
	total += i
end
local i = "outer"
print(total, i)

-- the loop body's local captured, then the loop exits early
local saved
for n = 1, 10 do
	local sq = n * n
	if sq > 20 then
		saved = function()
			return sq
		end
		break
	end
end
print(saved())

local r = 0
repeat

	seen[r] = function()
		return stop
	end
until stop
print(r, seen[1](), seen[3]())

-- loops whose exits carry a value out, and a loop body that needs a goto to structure
do
	local Entry = {get = function() return {[2] = {seen = true}} end}
	local function seen(id)
		local e = Entry.get()[id]
		return e ~= nil and e.seen ~= nil
	end
	local function pick(tips)
		local index = nil
		for i, tip in tips do
			if tip.show and not seen(tip.id) then
				index = i
				break
			end
		end
		if index == nil then
			return false
		end
		local ok, v = pcall(function()
			return tips[index].id * 100
		end)
		return ok, v
	end
	print(pick({{show = false, id = 1}, {show = true, id = 2}, {show = true, id = 3}, {show = true, id = 4}}))
	print(pick({{show = true, id = 2}}))
end
do
	local function nextShown(tips, from)
		local index = nil
		for i = from + 1, #tips do
			if tips[i].toShow then
				index = i
				break
			end
		end
		if index ~= nil then
			return "show " .. index .. " " .. tips[index].id
		end
		return "none"
	end
	local tips = {{toShow = true, id = "a"}, {toShow = false, id = "b"}, {toShow = true, id = "c"}}
	print(nextShown(tips, 0), nextShown(tips, 1), nextShown(tips, 3))
end
do
	local function findKey(t, want)
		local key = nil
		for k, v in t do
			if v == want then
				key = k
				break
			end
		end
		if key ~= nil then
			return "found " .. key
		end
		return "none"
	end
	print(findKey({"x", "y", "z"}, "y"), findKey({"x"}, "q"))
end
do
	local function conv(list)
		local out = {}
		for _, v in list do
			if typeof(v) ~= "number" then
				v = tonumber(v) or -1
			end
			table.insert(out, v * 2)
		end
		return table.concat(out, ",")
	end
	local function conv2(n)
		local out = {}
		for i = 1, n do
			if i % 2 == 0 then
				i = i * 100
			end
			table.insert(out, i)
		end
		return table.concat(out, ",")
	end
	print(conv({1, "2", "x", 4}), conv2(4))
end
do
	local function m(items, opts)
		local res = {}
		for _, it in items do
			if it.name then
				local n = it.name
				if opts and opts.skip and opts.skip[n .. "*"] then
					res[n] = "skip*"
				elseif opts and opts.skip and opts.skip[n] then
					res[n] = "skip"
				else
					local k = it.kind
					if k == 1 then
						res[n] = "one"
					elseif k == 2 then
						res[n] = "two"
					else
						if k ~= 3 then
							continue
						end
						res[n] = "three"
					end
				end
			else
				if it.kind ~= 9 then
					continue
				end
				res.schema = "s"
			end
		end
		local keys = {}
		for k, v in res do table.insert(keys, k .. "=" .. v) end
		table.sort(keys)
		return table.concat(keys, ",")
	end
	local items = {{name = "a", kind = 1}, {name = "b", kind = 2}, {name = "c", kind = 3}, {name = "d", kind = 4}, {kind = 9}, {name = "e", kind = 1}, {name = "f", kind = 1}}
	print(m(items, nil))
	print(m(items, {skip = {["a*"] = true, b = true}}))
	print(m(items, {}))
end

-- comparisons a decompiler can't flip: with NaN, `not (a < b)` isn't `a >= b`, and `x ~= x` is
-- true. Also and/or chains where a false or nil value in the middle changes which side wins
local nan = 0 / 0
local values = { 1, -1, 0, nan, math.huge, -math.huge }

local function compare(a, b)
	local out = {}
	if not (a < b) then out[#out + 1] = "!lt" end
	if not (a <= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!le" end
	if not (a > b) then out[#out + 1] = "!gt" end
	if not (a >= b) then out[#out + 1] = "!ge" end
	if a ~= a then out[#out + 1] = "self" end
	if not (a == b) then out[#out + 1] = "!eq" end
	while not (a < b) do
		out[#out + 1] = "w"
		break
	end
	local rounds = 0
	repeat
		rounds += 1
		out[#out + 1] = "r"
	until not (a > b) or rounds == 2
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end

for i = 1, #values do
	for j = 1, #values do
		print(i, j, compare(values[i], values[j]))
	end
end

-- values, not just truthiness
local function pick(a, b, c)
	local x = a and b or c
	local y = a and (b or c)
	local z = (a or b) and c
	local w = not a == not b
	local v = a and false or c
	local u = a == nil and b or nil
	return x, y, z, w, v, u
end
local samples = { true, false, nil, 0, "", nan }
for i = 1, 6 do
	for j = 1, 6 do
		for k = 1, 6 do
			local a, b, c = samples[i], samples[j], samples[k]
			print(i, j, k, pick(a, b, c))
		end
	end
end

-- shapes from inlined helpers with control flow (-O2 copies them into their callers)

local flags = { force = false, edge = true }
local layers = { get = function(_, key) return { fromEdge = key == "edge" } end }
local urls = {}
urls.delivery = "https://delivery/"
urls.plain = "https://plain/"

-- early returns, one inside a condition with a call in it, inlined into an argument
local function resolveHost()
	if flags.force then
		return urls.delivery
	end
	if flags.edge then
		local data = layers:get("edge")
		if data and data.fromEdge then
			return urls.delivery
		end
	end
	return urls.plain
end
local function fetchIcons(ids)
	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))
end
print(fetchIcons({ 1, 2 }))
flags.edge = false
print(fetchIcons({ 3 }))

-- a return from inside a loop
local function hasName(names, name)
	if type(names) == "table" then
		for _, n in names do
			if n == name then
				return true
			end
		end
	elseif type(names) == "string" then
		return names == name
	end
	return false
end
local function matches(schema, value)
	if schema.kind ~= value.kind or schema.name ~= nil and not hasName(schema.name, value.name) then
		return "no"
	end
	return "yes"
end
print(matches({ kind = 1, name = { "a", "b" } }, { kind = 1, name = "b" }), matches({ kind = 1, name = "x" }, { kind = 1, name = "y" }))

-- `return a and b and f()`, with f returning early
local vr = false
local function supported()
	if vr then
		return flags.force
	end
	return true
end
local function enabled(a, b)
	return a and b and supported()
end
print(enabled(true, true), enabled(true, false))
vr = true
print(enabled(true, true))

-- a helper inlined into one that is inlined in turn, returning from a loop
local function escape(s)
	if s == "" then
		return "%00"
	end
	return (s:gsub("%.", "%%2E"))
end
local function segmentFor(node, known)
	if node.parent ~= nil then
		for _, entry in known do
			if entry.node == node then
				return entry.segment
			end
		end
	end
	return escape(node.name)
end
local function pathOf(node, known)
	local parts = {}
	while node do
		table.insert(parts, 1, segmentFor(node, known))
		node = node.parent
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end
local root = { name = "" }
local mid = { name = "a.b", parent = root }
local leaf = { name = "c", parent = mid }
print(pathOf(leaf, { { node = mid, segment = "M" } }), pathOf(leaf, {}))

-- a helper whose returns all lead to its caller's end
local picks, misses = {}, 0
local function pick(x)
	local hit = if x > 2 then x * 10 else nil
	if hit ~= nil then
		table.insert(picks, hit)
		return
	end
	if x < 0 then
		misses += 1
	end
end
local function onInput(kind, x, blocked)
	if kind == "click" then
		if not blocked then
			pick(x)
		end
	elseif kind == "touch" then
		misses += 100
	end
end
onInput("click", 5, false)
onInput("click", -1, false)
onInput("click", 9, true)
onInput("touch", 0, false)
print(table.concat(picks, ","), misses)

-- `continue` in a `repeat` goes to its condition
local function walk(list)
	local out, i, stack = {}, 0, list
	repeat
		i += 1
		local v = stack[i]
		if v == nil or v == false then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(out, v)
	until i >= #stack
	return table.concat(out, ",")
end
print(walk({ 1, false, 3, 4 }))

	if flags.force then

	return string.format("%sicons?ids=%s", resolveHost(), table.concat(ids, ","))

-- metatable classes with methods
local Account = {}
Account.__index = Account

function Account.new(owner, balance)
	local self = setmetatable({}, Account)
	self.owner = owner
	self.balance = balance or 0
	self.history = {}
	return self
end

function Account:deposit(amount)
	if amount <= 0 then
		error("deposit must be positive")
	end
	self.balance += amount
	table.insert(self.history, { kind = "deposit", amount = amount })
end

function Account:withdraw(amount)
	if amount > self.balance then
		return false, "insufficient funds"
	end
	self.balance -= amount
	table.insert(self.history, { kind = "withdraw", amount = amount })
	return true
end

function Account:statement()
	local lines = {}
	for index, entry in ipairs(self.history) do
		lines[index] = ("%s %d"):format(entry.kind, entry.amount)
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local savings = Account.new("sam", 100)
savings:deposit(50)
local ok, reason = savings:withdraw(500)
if not ok then
	print(reason)
end

	for _, b in ipairs({ 2, -2, 0.5, 3 }) do

-- A* on a small grid map, with a binary heap for the open set.

local MAP = {
	"S....#....",
	".##..#.##.",
	".#...#..#.",
	".#.###..#.",
	"...#....#G",
	"##.#.####.",
	"..........",
}

local function parse(rows)
	local grid, start, goal = {}, nil, nil
	for y, row in ipairs(rows) do
		grid[y] = {}
		for x = 1, #row do
			local c = row:sub(x, x)
			grid[y][x] = c ~= "#"
			if c == "S" then
				start = { x = x, y = y }
			elseif c == "G" then
				goal = { x = x, y = y }
			end
		end
	end
	return grid, start, goal
end

local function key(x, y)
	return y * 1000 + x
end

local function heuristic(a, b)
	return math.abs(a.x - b.x) + math.abs(a.y - b.y)
end

local Heap = {}
Heap.__index = Heap

function Heap.new()
	return setmetatable({ items = {}, size = 0 }, Heap)
end

function Heap:push(node, priority)
	self.size += 1
	local i = self.size
	self.items[i] = { node = node, priority = priority }
	while i > 1 do
		local parent = i // 2
		if self.items[parent].priority <= self.items[i].priority then
			break
		end
		self.items[parent], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[parent]
		i = parent
	end
end

function Heap:pop()
	if self.size == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local top = self.items[1]
	self.items[1] = self.items[self.size]
	self.items[self.size] = nil
	self.size -= 1
	local i = 1
	while true do
		local smallest, left, right = i, i * 2, i * 2 + 1
		if left <= self.size and self.items[left].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = left
		end
		if right <= self.size and self.items[right].priority < self.items[smallest].priority then
			smallest = right
		end
		if smallest == i then
			break
		end
		self.items[smallest], self.items[i] = self.items[i], self.items[smallest]
		i = smallest
	end
	return top.node
end

local DIRECTIONS = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }

local function findPath(grid, start, goal)
	local open = Heap.new()
	local cameFrom, cost = {}, { [key(start.x, start.y)] = 0 }
	open:push(start, heuristic(start, goal))
	local visited = 0
	while open.size > 0 do
		local current = open:pop()
		visited += 1
		if current.x == goal.x and current.y == goal.y then
			local path = { current }
			local k = key(current.x, current.y)
			while cameFrom[k] do
				current = cameFrom[k]
				table.insert(path, 1, current)
				k = key(current.x, current.y)
			end
			return path, visited
		end
		for _, d in DIRECTIONS do
			local nx, ny = current.x + d[1], current.y + d[2]
			if not (grid[ny] and grid[ny][nx]) then
				continue
			end
			local nk = key(nx, ny)
			local newCost = cost[key(current.x, current.y)] + 1
